sentences.zh: 正恨高元海、畢義雲、高乾和誑惑聖上，疾忌忠良，但為殺此三人，即臨城自刎。

translations.literal: I only hate that Gao Yuanhai, Bi Yiyun, and Gao Qianhe delude the sage ruler and envy the loyal—kill these three alone and I will come to the wall and cut my own throat."
translations.idiomatic: I hate only that Gao Yuanhai, Bi Yiyun, and Gao Qianhe deceive the throne and destroy the loyal—kill these three and I will cut my own throat at the wall."

sentences.zh: 」既而城破，單騎北走，至交津，獲之，鎖送鄴。

translations.literal: Soon the city fell; he fled north alone on horseback, was taken at Jiaojin, chained, and sent to Ye.
translations.idiomatic: The city fell; he fled north alone, was taken at Jiaojin, chained, and sent to Ye.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，載以露車，銜木面縛。

translations.literal: On yisi, he was loaded on an open cart, wood in the mouth, face bound.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi he was loaded on an open cart, gag in mouth, face bound.

sentences.zh: 劉桃枝臨之以刃，擊鼓隨之，並其子孫十五人皆棄市。

translations.literal: Liu Taozhi held a blade over him; drums beat as they went; he and fifteen sons and grandsons were all exposed in the market and executed.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Taozhi held a blade to him; drums beat as they went; he and fifteen sons and grandsons died in the market.

sentences.zh: 命封子繪行冀州事。

translations.literal: Feng Zihui was ordered to act for Jizhou affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Feng Zihui was ordered to govern Jizhou.

sentences.zh: 齊主知歸彥前譖清河王岳，以歸彥家良賤百口賜岳家，贈岳太師。

translations.literal: The Qi ruler knew Guiyan had earlier slandered Prince Yue of Qinghe; he gave a hundred persons of Guiyan's household, bond and free, to Yue's family and posthumously honored Yue as Grand Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: The Qi ruler knew Guiyan had slandered Prince Yue of Qinghe; he gave a hundred of Guiyan's household, bond and free, to Yue's kin and posthumously honored Yue as grand preceptor.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，以段韶為太傅，婁睿為司徒，平陽王淹為太宰，斛律光為司空，趙郡王睿為尚書令，河間王孝琬為左僕射。

translations.literal: On dingyou, Duan Shao was made Grand Tutor, Lou Rui Minister of Education, Prince Yan of Pingyang Grand Mentor, Hu Lv Guang Minister of Works, Prince Rui of Zhao Director of the Secretariat, and Prince Xiaowan of Hejian Left Vice Director.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, Duan Shao became grand tutor, Lou Rui minister of education, Prince Yan of Pingyang grand mentor, Hu Lv Guang minister of works, Prince Rui of Zhao director of the Secretariat, and Prince Xiaowan of Hejian left vice director.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，齊主如晉陽。

translations.literal: On guihai, the Qi ruler went to Jinyang.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai the Qi ruler went to Jinyang.

sentences.zh: 上遣使聘齊。

translations.literal: The emperor sent envoys on a mission to Qi.
translations.idiomatic: The Chen emperor sent envoys to Northern Qi.

sentences.zh: 九月，戊辰朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the first day wuchen, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, first day wuchen, solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 以侍中、都官尚書到仲舉為尚書右僕射、丹楊尹。

translations.literal: Palace Attendant and Minister of Justice Dao Zhongju was made Right Vice Director of the Secretariat and Governor of Danyang.
translations.idiomatic: Palace attendant and minister of justice Dao Zhongju was made right vice director of the Secretariat and governor of Danyang.

sentences.zh: 仲舉，溉之弟子也。

translations.literal: Zhongju was nephew to Dao Gai.
translations.idiomatic: Zhongju was Dao Gai's nephew.

sentences.zh: 吳明徹至臨川，攻周迪，不能克。

translations.literal: Wu Mingche reached Linchuan and attacked Zhou Di but could not overcome him.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Mingche reached Linchuan and attacked Zhou Di but could not break him.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，詔安成王頊代之。

translations.literal: On dinghai, an edict ordered Prince Xu of Ancheng to replace him.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai the court ordered Prince Xu of Ancheng to replace him.

sentences.zh: 冬，十月，戊戌，詔以軍旅費廣，百姓空虛，凡供乘輿飲食衣服及宮中調度，悉從減削；

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on wuxu, an edict held that because military costs were vast and the people empty, all provisions for the imperial carriage—food, drink, clothing—and palace disbursements were to be cut;
translations.idiomatic: Winter, tenth month, on wuxu, an edict declared that war had emptied the land; food, drink, clothing for the throne, and palace expenses were all to be cut;

sentences.zh: 至於百司，宜亦思省約。

translations.literal: as for the hundred offices, they too should consider thrift.
translations.idiomatic: the hundred offices should practice thrift as well.

sentences.zh: 十一月，丁卯，周以趙國公招為益州總管。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on dingmao, Zhou made Duke Zhao of Zhao Inspector-General of Yizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, on dingmao, Northern Zhou made Duke Zhao of Zhao inspector-general of Yizhou.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，齊遣兼散騎常侍封孝琰來聘。

translations.literal: On dingchou, Qi sent Acting Regular Attendant of the Scattered Cavalry Feng Xiaoyan on a mission.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, Northern Qi sent acting attendant Feng Xiaoyan on an embassy.

sentences.zh: 十二月，丙辰，齊主還鄴。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on bingchen, the Qi ruler returned to Ye.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, on bingchen, the Qi ruler returned to Ye.

sentences.zh: 齊主逼通昭信李後，曰：「若不從我，我殺爾兒！

translations.literal: The Qi ruler forced himself on Empress Li of Zhaoxin, saying, "If you will not yield to me, I will kill your son!"
translations.idiomatic: The Qi ruler forced Empress Li of Zhaoxin, saying, "Refuse me and I kill your son!"

sentences.zh: 」後懼，從之。

translations.literal: The empress feared and yielded.
translations.idiomatic: She yielded in fear.

sentences.zh: 既而有娠。

translations.literal: Before long she was with child.
translations.idiomatic: Soon she was with child.

sentences.zh: 太原王紹德至閣，不得見，慍曰：「兒豈不知邪！

translations.literal: Prince Shaode of Taiyuan came to the gate but could not see her; angrily he said, "Does the boy not know!
translations.idiomatic: Prince Shaode of Taiyuan came to her door and was turned away; he raged, "Does the boy not know!

sentences.zh: 姊腹大，故不見兒。

translations.literal: Sister's belly is great—therefore she will not see the boy."
translations.idiomatic: Sister's belly swells—that is why she will not see me."

sentences.zh: 」後大慚，由是生女不舉。

translations.literal: The empress was deeply ashamed; from this she bore girls and did not rear them.
translations.idiomatic: The empress burned with shame; thereafter she bore girls and would not rear them.

sentences.zh: 帝橫刀詬曰：「殺我女，我何得不殺爾兒！

translations.literal: The emperor brandished a blade and cursed: "You killed my daughter—how can I not kill your son!"
translations.idiomatic: The emperor brandished a blade and snarled, "You killed my daughter—shall I not kill your son!"

sentences.zh: 」對後以刀環築殺紹德。

translations.literal: Before the empress he beat Shaode to death with the ring of the blade.
translations.idiomatic: Before the empress he beat Shaode to death with the blade's ring.

sentences.zh: 後大哭，帝愈怒，裸後，亂撾之。

translations.literal: The empress wailed greatly; the emperor grew still angrier, stripped her naked, and beat her at random.
translations.idiomatic: The empress wailed; the emperor, wilder still, stripped her and beat her at random.

sentences.zh: 後號天不已，帝命盛以絹囊，流血淋漉，投諸渠水。

translations.literal: The empress cried to heaven without cease; the emperor ordered her packed in a silk sack, blood streaming, and cast into a canal.
translations.idiomatic: She cried to heaven without end; he had her stuffed in a silk sack, blood streaming, and cast into a canal.

sentences.zh: 良久乃蘇，犢車載送妙勝寺為尼。

translations.literal: After long while she revived; an ox-cart carried her to Miaosheng Temple to become a nun.
translations.idiomatic: After long while she revived; an ox-cart bore her to Miaosheng Temple as a nun.
